caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair placed against a plain, light-colored background. The chair is illustrated in a three-quarter view, showing both the front and the left side. It features a flat seat, four sturdy square legs with side stretchers, and a high backrest. The backrest includes a decorative cut-out shape resembling an abstracted cross or "I" form at the center. The wood texture is detailed with visible grain and some indications of roughness or wear, rendered in shades of brown and tan, giving a natural wooden appearance. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition, and the chair occupies the central area of the image. In the lower right corner, there are small printed or handwritten words.
title: Monk's Chair
